notes.title: The Full Release HAS ARRIVED!!! ...with a bonus
notes.content:
At long last the first full official build of Crypt is here! There were many challenges for the team in getting this all together and admittedly it has happened a good deal later than we planed but with the long wait comes a reward. in addition to further bug fixes  polished graphics and new features we have decided to release our first planned DLC The Black Tower for free as a part of the first official full build as a special thank you to you our users for sicking with us and helping us get this far consider it our gift to you.

Fix's-

1-minor bugs with enemy movement 

2- altered parts of the map to make movement easier 

2- bloom and other post processing visual effects updated to newer version 


New Features-

1- Full difficulty control scale the game from normal all the way to NIGHTMARE and challenge your build to the max

2- enhanced spells now unleash  even more magical destruction in final levels

3- New Game Mode Survival - fight against the clock to survive the endless horde- test your might and your builds in this brand new game mode can you stand the storm?

4- Brand New Act to the Campaign - The Black Tower-
the gates of hell now stand open before you, you've beaten every foe defeated every challenge ....but none can compare to this ....do you have what it takes to face the  inner demons of your own worst nightmares step through the gates and find out...


Lastly our future hope is to expand survival mode with multiple options for play and eventually online group 4 party multiplayer. Thanks again to everyone who has made this possible we will be adding and improving this build more over the coming months so please let us know what you think and help us continue to push this game to the next level.  

PS- good luck to all those attempting to beat the new final boss our testers all agree the Mofo is almost impossible...and that's on normal mode  :)

Matthew Cintron -Lead Dev Endless Void Studios

notes.title: We have finally reached Beta Release !!!
notes.content:
Beta Release is Finally Here!
and with it comes a whole mess of new updates fix's and features. Our team was hit by some set backs recently so it took much longer to get this into your hands than we hoped and for that we apologize. However we have resolved them strengthened the group with some new talent and are ready to give you the Beta release you our incredible supporters deserve in fact were incredibly exited about the way these new tools really change and add to the games over all ease of play and expirence.

Fix's-

1-minor bugs with final end credits scene handled

2- issues leaving and entering certain boss areas resolved

2- UI issues with items dropping, item equipping and destroying them for loot
have all been fixed as well  


New Features-

1- Full info on all controls available in the escape menu as well as on our website

2- ability to return to previous levels has now been created 

3- Graphics have been improved with post processing effects

4- New camera control features -

A-up down left right arrows will move the camera wherever you want it -

B-either ctrl button will halt all over the shoulder following so the camera tracks you but dose not rotate

C-either shift button will allow you to look around 

D- the page down button will reset the camera to its starting setting



Next on our list we will be releasing a expansion DLC for our game with a whole new act the Black Tower as well as a whole new survival mode and tons more updated features so stay tuned because this adventure is just getting started and we have whole lot more amazing content we can't wait to show you.

Matthew Cintron -Lead Dev Endless Void Studios

notes.title: Alpha Update 1.2 is Finally Here!!
notes.content:
Finally after a serious effort by our team the alpha build 1.2 has now been launched. We worked to add a bunch more weapons to the inventory fix some of the major bugs still being discussed and move the game right to the edge of its beta release. It took a ton of work and time but we have been literally swapped with comments reviews and demand for more content since our release so we pushed ourselves to get it to you all for your support means the world to us and now here it is.

Fix's-

1-improved portal interaction and level to level l movement

2- added more audio to elements that were missing it in the game

3- fixed minor bugs on attack hit-box detection


New Features-

1- New Epic Gear for all acts beyond the first

Each act now has its own groups of special epic weapons - 

1-Deep Weapons from the strange ore in the Dark Caves -
2-Goblin Weapons of blood and madness from the Forest clans
3- Sun Weapons of Fire from the Dessert sands
4- And Finally Frost Weapons from the Giants of Ice in the Frozen Mountain

You have a drop chance from all monsters in the level as you progress chances get better and you access more epic  weapons of power.Some lucky supporters of the game may already find one in their inventory when they load their save this is our gift to you for helping us build and support the game.


We will be heading on to our full beta release next where we will attempt to update the games whole platform and add post processing effects and polish to our controls. Thanks again for all your help making this possible guys it's not easy to devote this much time to a project but your support and advice has really made us raise the bar and we will continue to do so in the future as we expand this game to its full potential cheers.

Matthew Cintron -Lead Dev Endless Void Studios

notes.title: First Alpha Update build 1.1 is now LIVE!!
notes.content:
Thank so much for everyone who has given us feedback, reviews and Bug advice over the past week the support from the steam community to help us improve our product has been incredible. With that in mind the first update to our alpha build has now been launched. 

Fix's-

1-improved attack targeting and player model no longer blocks attacks or loot drop pic ups- as well as response time when using space bar instead of mouse click to attack 

2- added better serialization code to help with rare issue of lost saves please let us know if this continues this error was hard to reproduce so we are still making sure it is completely fixed. Users who still experience it should try closing and reopening the application.

3- improved camera movement when holding down shift- 


New Features-

1- New UI for action bar, spells and atributes

2- New Icons for all usable spells 

3- New mini map feature accessed by pressing M 

We will be building in more fix's to posted bugs and adding much more to our inventory loot items in the next build update so stay posted and please let us know when you find issues and what you would like to see from us in the future. We are a small team but we are dedicated to improving this product for you all. Thanks again for all your interest and continued support of our game.

Matthew Cintron -Lead Dev Endless Void Studios
